basic_info.description: Perched on the Western slope of Twin Peaks this beautifully updated midcentury home is detached on all sides and features a fantastic floor plan, a large 2 car garage and a private and secure rear yard. Three bedrooms including a primary with ensuite are located on the main floor and offer views of Sutro tower and the surrounding hills. The lower level contains a large ensuite 4th bedroom that offers amazing flexibility to be used as a recreation room, office, gym or private guest suite. Recently updated with all new bathrooms and a gorgeous new kitchen, the open concept living area is dominated by a waterfall island with breakfast bar, large windows that look out on California Bay trees, and a stunningly tiled fireplace. With an additional bathroom on the main level, a large two car garage, and incredibly special views of Sutro tower from the backyard patio this home satisfies the most discerning buyers. Unique to the neighborhood, 147 Gladeview is easily walkable to recently renovated Midtown Terrace Playground, Clarendon Elementary, and the Forest Hill Muni station.
